description: Source code for UE (User Equipment) cell management in a 5G NR scheduler, including HARQ handling, CSI reporting, link adaptation, and search space management.

classes.name: ue_cell
classes.description: Represents a User Equipment (UE) cell context in the scheduler, managing HARQ processes, CSI reports, link adaptation, and search space monitoring.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Stops HARQ retransmissions and marks the UE as inactive.

methods.name: handle_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Reconfigures HARQ parameters and other UE settings based on new configuration.

methods.name: set_fallback_state
methods.description: Sets the fallback mode state for the UE, cancelling HARQ retransmissions if needed.

methods.name: handle_dl_ack_info
methods.description: Processes downlink HARQ ACK/NACK information for a specific UCI slot.

methods.name: handle_crc_pdu
methods.description: Handles uplink CRC PDU indication, updating UL HARQ state and link adaptation.

methods.name: handle_srs_channel_matrix
methods.description: Updates channel state with SRS channel matrix information.

methods.name: handle_csi_report
methods.description: Processes CSI reports and adjusts link adaptation accordingly.

methods.name: get_active_dl_search_spaces
methods.description: Retrieves active downlink search spaces based on current configuration and monitoring conditions.

methods.name: get_active_ul_search_spaces
methods.description: Retrieves active uplink search spaces based on current configuration and monitoring conditions.

methods.name: get_aggregation_level
methods.description: Calculates the aggregation level for DCI based on CQI and search space info.

methods.name: apply_link_adaptation_procedures
methods.description: Adjusts link parameters based on CSI report data.

methods.name: get_estimated_dl_rate
methods.description: Estimates downlink data rate based on PDSCH configuration and MCS.

methods.name: get_estimated_ul_rate
methods.description: Estimates uplink data rate based on PUSCH configuration and MCS.

methods.name: set_conres_state
methods.description: Sets the ConRes procedure completion state and logs the event.
